tasks.subject: Task 0: Dependency path_provider + Isar.open on device
tasks.description:
**Goal:** `flutter pub add path_provider` (^2.1.6). `lib/local/isar_providers.dart`: `isarProvider = Provider<Isar>((_) => throw UnimplementedError('override in main'))`. `lib/main.dart`: `final dir = await getApplicationDocumentsDirectory(); final isar = await Isar.open([SettingsRecordSchema], directory: dir.path);` (an empty schema list throws `IsarError: At least one collection needs to be opened`, `isar.dart:65`; `settings_record.dart` + its codegen come here from Task 1).` then `ProviderScope(overrides: [isarProvider.overrideWithValue(isar)], child: TenpaiApp())`. Entry import is `package:isar_community/isar.dart`.

**Files:**
- pubspec.yaml
- lib/local/isar_providers.dart
- lib/main.dart

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] fresh flutter run boots, no Isar error in the console
- [ ] debugPrint(isar.directory) shows the app files dir (temporary)

**Verify:** flutter pub get && flutter analyze, then flutter run

```json:metadata
{"verifyCommand": "flutter pub get && flutter analyze, then flutter run", "acceptanceCriteria": ["fresh flutter run boots, no Isar error in the console", "debugPrint(isar.directory) shows the app files dir (temporary)"], "modelTier": "mechanical", "owner": "user (Claude confirms before add)", "files": ["pubspec.yaml", "lib/local/isar_providers.dart", "lib/main.dart"]}
```
**Done 2026-09-25**: `path_provider ^2.1.6`, `isarProvider` + root override, `Isar.open([SettingsRecordSchema])` (empty list throws); `settings_record.dart` moved here, `@enumerated ThemeMode` generates. Emulator boots clean.

tasks.subject: Task 1: Collections + codegen (settings, scan, yaku records)
tasks.description:

If `@enumerated ThemeMode` (enum from Flutter) does not generate, store `int themeModeIndex` and map in the repository; note it in the plan.

**Files:**

- lib/scanner/scan_record.dart
- lib/yaku/yaku_record.dart
- lib/main.dart

- [ ] app still boots with the schemas

tasks.subject: Task 2: Repositories: settings, scan history, yaku cache + CachedYakuRepository
tasks.description:
**Goal:** `SettingsRepository` + `IsarSettingsRepository(this._isar)` (`themeMode()` reads row 0 or `system`; `setThemeMode` = `writeTxn(put)`). `ScanHistoryRepository` + `IsarScanHistoryRepository` (`add(Tile)` = `writeTxn(put(ScanRecord..code = tile.code..scannedAt = DateTime.now()))`; `watch()` = `isar.scanRecords.where().sortByScannedAtDesc().watch(fireImmediately: true)`). `YakuCacheSource` (`read()`, `replace(list)`) + `IsarYakuCacheSource` (`replace` = one `writeTxn` with `clear()` + `putAll`). `CachedYakuRepository(this._remote, this._cache) implements YakuRepository`: network first, cache fallback, rethrow on empty cache, `debugPrint` on fallback.

**Files:**
- lib/settings/settings_repository.dart
- lib/settings/isar_settings_repository.dart
- lib/scanner/scan_history_repository.dart
- lib/scanner/isar_scan_history_repository.dart
- lib/yaku/yaku_cache_source.dart
- lib/yaku/isar_yaku_cache_source.dart
- lib/yaku/cached_yaku_repository.dart

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] CachedYakuRepository policy unit-testable with fakes (remote ok → replace called; remote throws + cache → cached list; remote throws + empty → rethrow)
- [ ] only the Isar impls import isar_community

**Verify:** flutter analyze && dart run tool/check_conventions.dart

```json:metadata
{"verifyCommand": "flutter analyze && dart run tool/check_conventions.dart", "acceptanceCriteria": ["CachedYakuRepository policy unit-testable with fakes (remote ok → replace called; remote throws + cache → cached list; remote throws + empty → rethrow)", "only the Isar impls import isar_community"], "modelTier": "standard", "owner": "user", "files": ["lib/settings/settings_repository.dart", "lib/settings/isar_settings_repository.dart", "lib/scanner/scan_history_repository.dart", "lib/scanner/isar_scan_history_repository.dart", "lib/yaku/yaku_cache_source.dart", "lib/yaku/isar_yaku_cache_source.dart", "lib/yaku/cached_yaku_repository.dart"]}
```
**Done 2026-09-25**: three interfaces + three Isar impls + `CachedYakuRepository` (`on Exception`, network first, cache fallback, rethrow on empty). Analyzer clean, suite 210.

ThemeMode.system`. `scanner_providers.dart`: `scanHistoryRepositoryProvider`, `scanHistoryProvider = StreamProvider<List<ScanRecord>>`, `masteredTilesProvider = Provider<int>` (distinct codes), `scan()` after `found` → `try { await add(tile) } catch (e, s) { debugPrint }`. `yaku_providers.dart`: `yakuRepositoryProvider` → `CachedYakuRepository(YakuRepositoryImpl(remote), IsarYakuCacheSource(isar))`.
